responsibility: Declares the top-level analyzer entry point used by the GCC pass. Its role is intentionally narrow: it exposes run_checkers, which triggers construction and execution of the analyzer engine, while the substantive engine, graph, and model types are declared elsewhere.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the narrow public declaration of the run_checkers entrypoint, in contrast to engine.cc, which implements the analyzer engine and its supporting runtime infrastructure.
